values: 携带家族的忠勇与荣耀的轻骑兵，在战场上穿梭自如，像尖锐的矛刺向后方的敌人。
A light cavalry warrior who fights for her family's honor, moving freely across the battlefield and piercing enemy defenses with her lance.
Let the light be my strength!
瑞恩的旗帜，永远不会倒下！
I'll fight in the name of House Rayne!
为了帝国，我将肃清敌人！
I shall wipe out all enemies for the Lightbearer Empire!
好漂亮的礼物！连阿曼达也喜欢它呢！
This is beautiful! Even Amanda likes it!
谢谢，我一定会珍藏它的。
我要避开班题斯的亡灵，哼
Ugh, I'll steer clear of the Graveborn from Bantus.
真希望战场上也能有充足的食物
If only the battlefield were this well-stocked...
爱丝特瑞达的爱马名为阿曼达，个性和她一样倔强。
Estrilda has a horse named Amanda, who is every bit as stubborn as she is.
灰影郡的居民经常能看到爱丝特瑞达骑着战马在边界地带巡游，瑞恩家族的旗帜在她身后飘扬。
Residents of Ashvale County are used to seeing Estrilda patrol the border on horseback, the banner of House Rayne fluttering behind her.
即使身处战场，爱丝特瑞达也很少穿着沉重的盔甲，她习惯以速度取胜。
Even on the battlefield, Estrilda rarely wears heavy armor, as she relies on speed to gain the upper hand.
爱丝特瑞达小时候很怕黑，但为了应对班题斯的一次次夜袭，她开始强迫自己进行最严苛的夜间训练，战胜对黑暗的恐惧。
When she was little, Estrilda dreaded the dark. But to prepare for Bantus' nighttime raids, she forced herself through grueling night training until she overcame her fear.
在瑞恩家族里，爱丝特瑞达是最乖巧的那个孩子。但如果上课时间她没有出现在训练场上，那只有一种可能：巴登又带她外出游玩，而且忘记了返回的时间。
Estrilda was the most well-behaved child in House Rayne. If she ever skipped training, there could only be one reason: Baden had taken her out on a trip and lost track of time.
爱丝特瑞达喜欢收集香水，却从不喷洒。在灰影郡前线，亡灵的气味也是判断班题斯动向的重要线索，而香水会影响她的判断。

Estrilda is an avid perfume collector, but she never wears any. On the frontier, the scent of Graveborn is an important clue for tracking Bantus' movements, and perfume would interfere with her judgment.
瑞恩家族庄园里豢养着许多奇特的动物，比如野狼、巨熊、鳄鱼——它们都是爱丝特瑞达从前线带回来的、因被班题斯驱使作战而丧失了生存能力的野兽。

House Rayne's estate is home to many unusual animals, including wolves, bears, and crocodiles. Estrilda brought them back from the battlefield after they were forced to fight for Bantus and lost the ability to survive in the wild.
爱丝特瑞达的骑枪轻巧、坚韧、锋利，出自耀光帝国最有名的工匠之手，是她的父亲前往赛凡纳谒见国王时特意为她定制的。

The lightweight, sharp, yet durable lance Estrilda wields was forged by the most renowned craftsman in the Lightbearer Empire. Her father had it made during a trip to Savannah for an audience with the king.
爱丝特瑞达非常擅长整蛊。在这方面，巴登是她的老师，瑟恩则是他们的“实验品”。
Estrilda is an expert prankster, second only to Baden. Thane, meanwhile, is their favorite "victim".
继任家主后，每逢生日，爱丝特瑞达都会回到家族庄园，在存放着历任家主画像的画廊里独自度过一整天。
On every birthday since becoming the family head, Estrilda returns to her family estate and spends the entire day alone in the gallery where portraits of the family's former heads are displayed.
抱歉，<style="stress"><player_name></style>，我并非故意向你们隐瞒我的真实名字。
I'm sorry, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I wasn't trying to hide my real name from you.
其实比起剑术，我更擅长用长枪。
I'm actually better with a spear than a sword.
又要与班题斯交手了，而且还是在班题斯的领土上。
And now we're going up against Bantus again—on their own ground, no less.
瑟恩（未完整） & 爱丝特瑞达
好久没有跳舞，感觉舞步都有些生疏了。
It's been so long since I danced. I'm getting rusty.
